        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;         "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

        "contents": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:\n\n   - &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;: PostgreSQL connection string\n   - &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - &#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - OAuth providers (optional for local dev)\n   - SMTP settings (for email magic links)\n\n1. Start Docker services and set up database:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended - checks Docker, starts containers, waits for DB, pushes schema, seeds)\n   npm run db:setup\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Or manually:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Check Docker Desktop is running\n   npm run db:check\n\n   # Start Docker containers\n   npm run docker:up\n\n   # Wait for database to be ready\n   npm run db:wait\n\n   # Push database schema\n   npm run db:push\n\n   # Seed database\n   npm run db:seed\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   **Troubleshooting**: If you encounter Docker issues, see [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)\n\n1. Start the development server:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOpen [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.\n\n## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;: PostgreSQL connection string",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Start Docker services and set up database:",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "   npm run db:setup",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "   Or manually:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Check Docker Desktop is running",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "   npm run db:check",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Start Docker containers",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "   npm run docker:up",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Wait for database to be ready",

          },
          {
            "text": "   npm run db:wait",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Push database schema",

          },
          {
            "text": "   npm run db:push",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Seed database",

          },
          {
            "text": "   npm run db:seed",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "   **Troubleshooting**: If you encounter Docker issues, see [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {

          },

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2. Kuidas migreerida lehte\n\n1. **Lisa &#96;useTranslations&#96; hook**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Asenda hardcoded stringid**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // Enne:\n   &lt;h1&gt;Vouchers&lt;/h1&gt;\n   \n   // Pärast:\n   &lt;h1&gt;{t('vouchers')}&lt;/h1&gt;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Kasuta &#96;Link&#96; komponenti &#96;@/routing&#96;'ist**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { Link } from '@/routing';\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. URL struktuur\n\nPraegu:\n- &#96;/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (inglise keel)\n- &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (eesti keel)\n- &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (hispaania keel)\n\nKõik lehed peaksid toetama locale prefix'it.\n\n## 📝 Järgmised sammud\n\n1. **Migreeri kõige kasutatavamad lehed** (login, voucher, referral)\n2. **Testi kõik keeled**\n3. **Lisa puuduvad tõlked** (kui vaja)\n4. **Paranda URL struktuuri** (kui vaja)\n\n## 🎯 Eesmärk",

          },

            "lineNumber": 28
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)\n\n## 📋 Done Definition Verification\n\nTo verify MVP is complete, test locally:\n\n1. ✅ Open voucher page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. ✅ Create referral (click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\")\n3. ✅ Share link (native share or copy)\n4. ✅ Friend redeems (open link in incognito, redeem)\n5. ✅ Staff confirms (go to redemptions, click confirm)\n6. ✅ Credit appears locked (check wallet)\n7. ✅ Credit unlocks (after confirmation, check wallet)\n8. ✅ Credit applied in checkout demo (go to checkout-demo, apply credit)\n\n## 🎯 Launch Readiness\n\n### Ready\n- ✅ Core flows working\n- ✅ MVP pages complete\n- ✅ Security &amp; fraud prevention\n- ✅ PWA functional\n- ✅ Data model correct\n- ✅ Business rules enforced\n\n### Needs Attention\n- ⚠️ Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page\n- ⚠️ Test all 8 done definition steps\n- ⚠️ Verify iOS PWA compatibility\n- ⚠️ Add feature flags (launch mode)\n\n### V2 (Documented Only)\n- 📝 See &#96;V2_BACKLOG.md&#96;\n- 📝 See &#96;LAUNCH_MODE.md&#96;\n\n## Summary\n\n**Status**: ✅ **MVP COMPLIANT** (with minor cleanup needed)\n\nThe platform matches the specification. All core flows work, MVP pages are present, forbidden features are absent, and the design aligns with requirements.\n\nMinor cleanup:\n- Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page\n- Test all 8 done definition steps\n- Add feature flags for launch mode",

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\n\nexport default async function AdminPage() {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  // Simple admin check - in production, use proper platform_admin flag\n  const isAdmin = process.env.PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS?.split(',').includes(session.user.email || '');\n\n  if (!isAdmin) {\n    redirect('/app');\n  }\n\n  const [merchantCount, userCount, voucherCount, redemptionCount] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.merchant.count(),\n    prisma.user.count(),\n    prisma.voucher.count(),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen p-4\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "export default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\nconst [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await \n\n\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Revenue: sum of paid voucher purchases\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Outstanding liability: sum of voucher values for paid but unredeemed purchases\n    // We need to calculate this differently - sum of voucher.value where purchase is paid but not redeemed\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n        voucher: {\n          redemptions: {\n            none: {\n              confirmedAt: { not: null },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { value: true },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    // Ticket revenue: sum of paid ticket purchases\n    prisma.ticketPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Tickets sold count\n    prisma.ticket.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['sold', 'used'] },\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n}",

Rakendus on tõesti väga minimaalne. Probleemid:
1. Pealeht on tühi — ainult pealkiri, tagline ja üks nupp
2. Puudub navigatsioon — ei saa funktsioone vaadata
3. Ei näidata, mida platvorm teeb — puuduvad näited või demo

## PLAN (võimalused)

**Valik 1: Minimaalne täiendus (soovitatud)**
- Lisada pealehele navigatsioon (header)
- Lisada funktsioonide sektsioon (mida platvorm teeb)
- Lisada näited/demo linkid
- Failid: `app/[locale]/home-client.tsx`, `app/[locale]/layout.tsx` (kui puudub header)

**Valik 2: Täielik landing page**
- Kõik valik 1 + hero, funktsioonid, testimoniaalid, CTA sektsioonid
- Rohkem failide muutmist

**Valik 3: Ainult navigatsioon**
- Lisada header navigatsiooniga
- Pealeht jääb minimaalseks

Soovitan valikut 1 — minimaalne, aga kasulik. Kas jätkan sellega või eelistad teist varianti?

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# Pilot Program: First 10 Merchants\n\n**Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit** — proof, learning, testimonials.  \nNot scale.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Merchant Selection Checklist\n\nUse this **before** outreach. A prospect must satisfy ALL in Section A and at least one in Section B.  \nIf any Section A item is NO → skip.\n\n### Section A — Must have (all YES)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Local or regional business (not national/global) | | |\n| 2 | High trust, repeat customers (regulars) | | |\n| 3 | Easy-to-understand service or product | | |\n| 4 | Owner involved in daily operations | | |\n| 5 | Comfortable with WhatsApp, phone, or email | | |\n\n### Section B — Best fit (at least one)\n\n| # | Category | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Café or coffee shop | |\n| 2 | Salon or barbershop | |\n| 3 | Gym or studio | |\n| 4 | Tool rental or service business | |\n| 5 | Small retail with regulars | |\n\n### Section C — Exclude (any YES → skip)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Big chain or franchise | |\n| 2 | Pure e‑commerce (no in‑person/regulars) | |\n| 3 | Discount‑driven / race‑to‑bottom positioning | |\n\n**Verdict:** _________________________________ (IN / OUT)  \n**Reason if OUT:** _________________________________\n\n---\n\n## 2. Outreach Script\n\n### 2a. Opening (DM / WhatsApp / SMS)\n\n&gt; I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers into your best salespeople, without ads.  \n&gt; Can I show you in 10 minutes?\n\n*If they say yes:*  \n&gt; When’s a good 10‑minute slot this week? I can call or stop by.\n\n*If they ask “what is it?”:*  \n&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. You control the offer and the credit. I’ll set it up with you.\n\n---\n\n### 2b. Phone / in‑person (10‑minute show)\n\n**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;\n   - Fill in the form and create a voucher\n\n4. **Share voucher**:\n   - View the voucher at &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96; to check Docker status\n- Start Docker Desktop manually from Start Menu\n- See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md][troubleshooting] for detailed solutions\n\n**Database connection error**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:wait&#96; to wait for database\n- Check Docker containers: &#96;npm run docker:logs&#96;\n- Ensure Docker is running: &#96;docker ps&#96;\n- Restart: &#96;npm run docker:down &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up&#96;\n\n**Port already in use**:\n\n- Change port in &#96;package.json&#96;: &#96;\"dev\": \"next dev -p 3001\"&#96;\n\n**Auth not working**:\n\n- Ensure AUTH_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are set in .env\n- For email magic links, configure SMTP settings\n- For OAuth, add provider credentials\n\n**PWA icons missing**:",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "const initial: FormData = {\n  type: 'percentage',\n  value: '',\n  currency: 'USD',\n  validFrom: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],\n  validTo: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],\n  usageLimitTotal: '',\n  usageLimitPerUser: '',\n  weeklyDropEnabled: false,\n  weeklyDropDay: '1',\n  weeklyDropTime: '10:00',\n  weeklyDropStock: '20',\n  weeklyDropDuration: '60',\n  designHeadline: '',\n  designFinePrint: '',\n  designPrimaryColor: '#18181b',\n  designSecondaryColor: '#71717a',\n  designBackgroundColor: '#fafafa',\n  codePrefix: '',\n};\n\nfunction VoucherPreview({ form }: { form: FormData }) {\n  const val = parseInt(form.value, 10) || 0;\n  const valueStr =\n    form.type === 'percentage'\n      ? &#96;${val}%&#96;\n      : formatCurrency(val * 100, form.currency);\n  const headline = form.designHeadline || 'Voucher';\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"voucher-preview w-full max-w-[320px] mx-auto lg:mx-0 rounded-lg border border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden bg-[var(--preview-bg)]\"&gt;\n      &lt;style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: &#96;.voucher-preview{--preview-bg:${form.designBackgroundColor};--preview-primary:${form.designPrimaryColor}}&#96; }} /&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"px-5 pt-5 pb-4 text-white bg-[var(--preview-primary)]\"&gt;\n        &lt;h3 className=\"text-xl font-semibold\"&gt;{headline}&lt;/h3&gt;\n        &lt;p className=\"mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums\"&gt;{valueStr}&lt;/p&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"px-5 py-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n          Valid until {new Date(form.validTo).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium' })}\n        &lt;/p&gt;\n        {form.designFinePrint &amp;&amp; (\n          &lt;p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2\"&gt;{form.designFinePrint}&lt;/p&gt;\n        )}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function NewVoucherPage() {\n  const params = useParams();\n}",

        "contents": "# Quick Start Guide\n\n## Ühe käsuga (soovitus) — &#96;dev:full&#96;\n\nKui Docker Desktop on käivitatud:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee käivitab: Postgres, loob/värskendab &#96;.env.local&#96;, teeb &#96;db push&#96;, &#96;db:seed&#96; ja &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;, siis dev-serveri.\n\n**Testikasutaja:** &#96;test@example.com&#96; / &#96;test123&#96;  \n**Lehed:** &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → /app (Coffee House: Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard)\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ installed\n- Docker Desktop installed and running\n- Git (optional)\n\n## Setup Steps\n\n1. **Install dependencies**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set up environment**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Copy the example env file\n   # Edit .env and set:\n   # - AUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - NEXTAUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - DATABASE_URL (already set for Docker)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Start database and initialize**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended)\n   npm run db:setup\n   \n   # Or manually:\n   npm run db:check      # Check Docker Desktop\n   npm run docker:up     # Start containers\n   npm run db:wait       # Wait for database\n   npm run db:push       # Push schema\n   npm run db:seed       # Seed data\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Start development server**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Open browser**:\n   Navigate to &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt;\n\n## Test the Flow\n\n1. **View a voucher** (after creating one):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&gt;\n   - Replace [voucherId] with an actual voucher ID from your database\n   - Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Login** (e‑post + parool):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt;\n   - [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) / **test123** (Credentials; töötab kohe kui &#96;dev:full&#96; või &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; on käivitatud)\n   - Või [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com) — magic link (vajab SMTP) või OAuth\n\n3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.\n\n**Minute 5–7 — Why pilot**  \n&gt; I’m running this with 10 local businesses to see what works. For the pilot it’s free, I do the setup with you, and you get your own branded voucher. In return I’d want a short feedback call and, if it works, your okay to use the results.\n\n**Minute 8–10 — Close**  \n&gt; No contract. If it doesn’t fit, we stop. Want to try it for a few weeks?\n\n---\n\n### 2c. Do NOT say\n\n- “startup”\n- “beta”\n- “platform”\n- “app”\n\nUse: “we’re testing,” “system,” “voucher,” “credit,” “weekly drop.”\n\n---\n\n### 2d. Objection short replies\n\n| Objection | Reply |\n| --- | --- |\n| “I don’t have time.” | “Setup is one short session. After that it runs itself. 10 minutes to see it?” |\n| “Will it cost me?” | “Pilot is free. If we continue after, it would be a small monthly fee and a small amount per referral. We can talk then.” |\n| “My customers won’t share.” | “That’s what we’re testing. If almost no one shares, we’ll change the offer or drop it. No risk for you.” |\n| “I already have loyalty / discounts.” | “This is different: they only get credit when they bring a new person who actually shows up. It rewards bringing new customers.” |\n\n---\n\n## 3. Pilot Setup Checklist (per merchant)\n\nDo this in one session.         "contents": "# Vouchr — Brand Positioning\n\n**Product name:** Vouchr  \n**Tagline:** Pay for results, not reach.\n\n---\n\n## One-paragraph positioning\n\nVouchr is merchant-owned referral infrastructure for local and regional businesses that rely on word-of-mouth. Instead of coupons, ads, or a marketplace, it lets you issue branded vouchers, turn loyal customers into a measurable, reward-based distribution channel, and pay them in your own store credit when their friends buy. You keep control of the brand and the relationship, and you only pay when a referred customer converts—not for clicks or impressions. Referral, measured and rewarded, for SMBs who want new customers and trust without losing control or budget to low-ROI ads.\n\n---\n\n## 10-second spoken pitch\n\n&gt; When a customer shares your voucher with a friend and that friend buys, the customer earns your store credit. It’s all branded, tracked, and controlled by you—and you only pay when it works.\n\n---\n\n## Homepage hero (1 sentence)\n\n&gt; Turn your best customers into your best salespeople—and only pay when it actually works.\n\n---\n\n## Core promise\n\n&gt; Turn your best customers into your best salespeople—and only pay when it actually works.\n\n---\n\n## What to say / not say\n\n**Never say:** discount platform, deal site, promo tool.  \n**Always say:** referral, credit, merchant-owned, pay-for-results.\n\n---\n\n## ICP\n\n- **Primary:** Local &amp; regional merchants (cafes, salons, gyms, rentals, services, retail); SMBs who rely on word-of-mouth; businesses tired of ads with unclear ROI.\n- **Secondary:** Franchise-style and multi-location SMBs.\n- **Not for:** Influencer marketers, big-brand ad buyers, discount hunters.\n\n---\n\n## Pricing positioning (no numbers)\n\n- Infrastructure, not marketing.\n- Cheaper than ads.\n- Pay only when value is created.  \n**Phrase:** \"You pay for customers, not clicks.\"\n\n---\n\n## Objection handling\n\n| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. This rewards referrals. |\n| \"Will people abuse it?\" | Credits are locked, controlled, and merchant-specific. |",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "Use only after a **GO** and when the merchant has seen some results.\n\n&gt; This has been free while we tested.  \n&gt; If we keep this running, it will be a small monthly fee plus a small cost per successful referral.  \n&gt; We can talk numbers when you’re ready — no pressure.\n\n**Do NOT push pricing. Gauge reaction.**\n\n- If positive: *“I’ll send you the options in a couple of days.”*\n- If hesitant: *“No rush. We can run another week or two as is and then decide.”*\n- If no: *“Understood. We’ll turn it off when you prefer. Thanks for trying it.”*\n\n---\n\n## 7. Action Plan — Week by Week\n\nDo in order. Adjust dates to your start.\n\n### Before you start\n\n| # | Task | ✓ |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | List 15–20 candidate businesses (use Section 1 checklist; aim to get 10 IN) | |\n| 2 | Get contact: WhatsApp, phone, or email for owner / decision‑maker | |\n| 3 | Prepare: demo &#96;/v/[id]&#96; and &#96;/r/[id]&#96; live or screens; 10‑min script (Section 2b) | |\n| 4 | Tracker: spreadsheet/notion with columns — Merchant, Category, Go‑live, Vouchers shared, Referrals, Redemptions, Credits earned, Credits used | |\n\n---\n\n### Week 1 — List + outreach\n\n| Day | Task |\n| --- | --- |\n| 1–2 | Run checklist on 15–20; mark IN/OUT. Pick first 5–7 to contact. |\n| 3–5 | DM/call using Section 2. Book 10‑min shows. In‑person best where possible. |\n| 6–7 | Do 10‑min shows.         "contents": "const prisma = new PrismaClient();\n\nasync function main() {\n  console.log('🌱 Seeding database...');\n\n  // Create merchants\n  const merchant1 = await prisma.merchant.create({\n    data: {\n      name: 'Coffee House',\n      slug: 'coffee-house',\n      country: 'US',\n      defaultCurrency: 'USD',\n      brandLogoUrl: null,\n      brandColorsJson: JSON.stringify({\n        primary: '#8B4513',\n        secondary: '#D2691E',\n        background: '#FFF8DC',\n      }),\n    },\n  });\n\n  const merchant2 = await prisma.merchant.create({\n    data: {\n      name: 'Tech Store',\n      slug: 'tech-store',\n      country: 'GB',\n      defaultCurrency: 'GBP',\n      brandLogoUrl: null,\n      brandColorsJson: JSON.stringify({\n        primary: '#0066CC',\n        secondary: '#003366',\n        background: '#F0F8FF',\n      }),\n    },\n  });\n\n  console.log('✅ Created merchants');\n\n  // Create users\n  const adminUser = await prisma.user.create({\n    data: {\n      email: 'admin@coffee-house.com',\n      name: 'Admin User',\n      emailVerified: new Date(),\n    },\n  });\n\n  const regularUser = await prisma.user.create({\n    data: {\n      email: 'user@example.com',\n      name: 'Regular User',\n      emailVerified: new Date(),\n    },\n  });\n\n  const testUser = await prisma.user.upsert({\n    where: { email: 'test@example.com' },\n    create: { email: 'test@example.com', name: 'Test User', emailVerified: new Date() },\n    update: {},\n  });\n\n  console.log('✅ Created users');\n\n  // Create merchant members\n  await prisma.merchantMember.create({\n    data: {\n      merchantId: merchant1.id,\n      userId: adminUser.id,\n      role: 'merchant_admin',\n    },\n  });\n\n  await prisma.merchantMember.create({\n    data: {\n      merchantId: merchant1.id,\n      userId: regularUser.id,\n      role: 'merchant_staff',\n    },\n  });\n\n  await prisma.merchantMember.upsert({\n    where:\n\n}",

Valmis. Muudatused tehtud.

## Muudetud failid

1. **`app/[locale]/layout.tsx`** — lisatud header navigatsiooniga
2. **`app/[locale]/home-client.tsx`** — täiendatud landing page:
   - Hero sektsioon
   - Funktsioonide sektsioon (6 funktsiooni)
   - "Kuidas see töötab" sektsioon (4 sammu)
   - CTA sektsioon
3. **`messages/en.json`** — lisatud inglise tõlked
4. **`messages/et.json`** — lisatud eesti tõlked

## Mida on lisatud

- Header navigatsioon — logo, lingid sektsioonidele, keelevalik, sisselogimise nupp
- Funktsioonide sektsioon — 6 kaardiga (bränditud kupongid, maksa tulemuste eest, kliendi preemiad, jne.)
- "Kuidas see töötab" — 4 sammu selgitusega
- CTA sektsioon — kutse alustamiseks
- Tõlked — inglise ja eesti keeles

## Testimine

1. Käivita dev server: `npm run dev`
2. Ava `http://localhost:3000`
3. Kontrolli:
   - Header navigatsioon
   - Funktsioonide sektsioon
   - "Kuidas see töötab" sektsioon
   - CTA sektsioon
   - Keelese vahetamine

Rakendus peaks nüüd nägema täielikum välja.

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred.         "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

- Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

Kõik muudatused on tehtud.

## Tehtud muudatused

### 1. Footer lisatud
- 4 veergu: toode, ettevõte, ressursid, info
- Linkid sektsioonidele
- Copyright teave
- Responsive disain

### 2. Smooth scroll parandatud
- CSS `scroll-behavior: smooth` lisatud globals.css
- Footer'is linkidele lisatud smooth scroll JavaScript

### 3. Tõlked lisatud
- Inglise keeles: footer teksti tõlked
- Eesti keeles: footer teksti tõlked

## Muudetud failid

1. `app/[locale]/home-client.tsx` — footer lisatud
2. `app/globals.css` — smooth scroll CSS lisatud
3. `messages/en.json` — footer tõlked
4. `messages/et.json` — footer tõlked

## Testimine

1. Käivita dev server: `npm run dev`
2. Ava `http://localhost:3000`
3. Kontrolli:
   - Footer lehe all
   - Navigatsiooni linkide smooth scroll
   - Footer linkide smooth scroll
   - Responsive disain

Rakendus on nüüd täielikum: header, funktsioonid, "Kuidas see töötab", CTA ja footer.

Kasutaja leht on täiendatud. Muudatused:

## Muudatused kasutaja lehel (`/app`)

### 1. Quick stats sektsioon
- 4 statistikat:
  - Available Credit (saadaval krediit)
  - Locked Credit (lukustatud krediit)
  - My Tickets (piletite arv)
  - Merchants (merchant'ide arv)

### 2. Quick Actions sektsioon
- 4 kiire tegevust ikoonidega:
  - My Tickets — vaata piletite lehte
  - Browse Vouchers — leia kuponge
  - Earn Credits — teeni krediite
  - Referrals — jälgi soovitusi

### 3. Parandatud merchant membership'id
- Parem kaardidisain
- Ikoonid nuppudel
- Hover efektid

## Muudetud failid

1. `app/app/page.tsx` — täiendatud rohkemate funktsioonidega

## Testimine

1. Logi sisse
2. Ava `/app`
3. Kontrolli:
   - 4 statistikat üleval
   - 4 quick action kaarti
   - Merchant membership'id all
   - Ikoonid ja hover efektid

Nüüd on kasutajale näha rohkem funktsioone.

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

          },

          {

          },

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96;
