        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste plaan\n\n## Prioriteet 1: UX täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications\n- ✅ Asendada kõik &#96;alert()&#96; kutsed toast notification'itega\n- ✅ Success, error, info toast'id\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ Button loading states\n- ✅ Page loading skeletons\n- ✅ Form submission indicators\n\n### 3. Analytics &amp; Statistika\n- ✅ Dashboard graafikud (Chart.js või Recharts)\n- ✅ Voucher performance metrics\n- ✅ Referral conversion rates\n- ✅ Credit usage analytics\n\n### 4. Parem Error Handling UI\n- ✅ Error boundaries\n- ✅ User-friendly error messages\n- ✅ Retry mechanisms\n\n## Prioriteet 2: Funktsionaalsed täiustused\n\n### 5. Voucher Otsing &amp; Filtreerimine\n- ✅ Otsing voucher'ite hulgas\n- ✅ Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n- ✅ Sortimine\n\n### 6. Voucher Mallid\n- ✅ Eeldefineeritud mallid\n- ✅ Mallide salvestamine\n- ✅ Kiire voucher'ite loomine mallidest\n\n### 7. Bulk Operations\n- ✅ Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine/pausimine\n- ✅ CSV export/import\n- ✅ Bulk redemptions\n\n### 8. Email Notifications\n- ✅ Credit unlock notifications\n- ✅ Redemption confirmations\n- ✅ Weekly drop reminders\n- ✅ Credit expiry warnings\n\n## Prioriteet 3: Täiendavad funktsioonid\n\n### 9. Parem Navigation\n- ✅ Mobile-friendly navigation\n- ✅ Breadcrumbs\n- ✅ Quick actions menu\n\n### 10. Export Funktsioonid\n- ✅ Redemptions CSV export\n- ✅ Credits ledger export\n- ✅ Analytics reports PDF\n\n### 11. Voucher Kategooriad\n- ✅ Kategooriate süsteem\n- ✅ Filtreerimine kategooria järgi\n- ✅ Kategooriate haldus\n\n### 12. Advanced Analytics\n- ✅ Referral tracking (UTM parameters)\n- ✅ Conversion funnels\n- ✅ Cohort analysis\n- ✅ Revenue attribution\n\n## Prioriteet 4: Tehnilised täiustused\n\n### 13. Caching Strategy\n- ✅ Redis caching public voucher pages\n- ✅ API response caching\n- ✅ Optimistic updates\n\n### 14. Performance\n- ✅ Image optimization\n- ✅ Code splitting\n- ✅ Lazy loading\n\n### 15. Testing",

Kokkuvõte tehtud täiendustest:

## Täidetud täiendused

### 1. Nädalapäevade tõlked
- Lisatud `voucher.daysOfWeek` objekt mõlemas keeles
- Nädalapäevad kasutavad nüüd tõlkeid dropdown'is

### 2. Toast sõnumite tõlked
- Lisatud uued tõlke võtmed:
  - `success.campaignCreated`
  - `success.eventCreated`
  - `success.merchantProfileUpdated`
  - `success.failedToCreateVoucher`
  - `success.failedToCreateCampaign`
  - `success.failedToCreateEvent`
  - `success.eventUpdated`
  - `success.failedToUpdateEvent`
  - `success.ticketRedeemed` (parameetriga)
  - `success.pleaseEnterQrToken`
  - `success.pleaseScanTicket`
  - `success.failedToLookupTicket`
  - `success.failedToRedeemTicket`

### 3. Parandatud failid
- `app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx` — toast sõnumid tõlgitud
- `app/merchant/[slug]/campaigns/new/page.tsx` — toast sõnumid tõlgitud
- `app/merchant/[slug]/events/new/page.tsx` — toast sõnumid tõlgitud
- `app/merchant/[slug]/events/[id]/edit/page.tsx` — toast sõnumid tõlgitud
- `app/merchant/[slug]/events/[id]/redeem/page.tsx` — toast sõnumid tõlgitud
- `app/merchant/[slug]/onboarding/page.tsx` — toast sõnumid tõlgitud

### 4. Tulemused
- Kõik toast sõnumid kasutavad tõlkeid
- Nädalapäevad on tõlgitud
- Ühtne tõlgete struktuur
- Parameetriga tõlked (nt `ticketRedeemed`)

## Järgmised võimalikud sammud

1. Error lehtede parandamine — kontrollida, kas kõik error lehed kasutavad tõlkeid
2. Form validation sõnumid — tõlkida valideerimise veateated
3. Accessibility parandused — lisada rohkem aria-label'e
4. Loading state'id — kontrollida, kas kõik loading state'id kasutavad tõlkeid
5. Placeholder'ite tõlked — kontrollida, kas kõik placeholder'id on tõlgitud

Kas jätkan mõnega neist?

---

_**User**_

kindlasti lisa kõik sotsiaal meedia sisselogimis võimalused ja jagamis võimalused igalepoole

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_


Kontrollin, mis on juba olemas, ja lisan puuduvad sotsiaalmeedia sisselogimise ja jagamise võimalused.

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service\n7. **Redis**: Create Redis service (optional)\n\n### Fly.io\n\n1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works",

        "contents": "// This is your Prisma schema file,\n// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema\n\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"postgresql\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\nmodel Account {\n  id                String  @id @default(cuid())\n  userId            String\n  type              String\n  provider          String\n  providerAccountId String\n  refresh_token     String? @db.Text\n  access_token      String? @db.Text\n  expires_at        Int?\n  token_type        String?\n  scope             String?\n  id_token          String? @db.Text\n  session_state     String?\n\n  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Session {\n  id           String   @id @default(cuid())\n  sessionToken String   @unique\n  userId       String\n  expires      DateTime\n  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel VerificationToken {\n  identifier String\n  token      String   @unique\n  expires    DateTime\n\n  @@unique([identifier, token])\n}\n\nmodel User {\n  id            String    @id @default(cuid())\n  email         String    @unique\n  emailVerified DateTime?\n  name          String?\n  image         String?\n  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  accounts         Account[]\n  sessions         Session[]\n  merchantMembers  MerchantMember[]\n  referrals        Referral[]         @relation(\"Referrer\")\n  redemptions      Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedBy\")\n  staffRedemptions Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedByStaff\")\n  creditLedgers    CreditLedger[]\n  creditUsages     CreditUsage[]\n  voucherPurchases VoucherPurchase[]\n  ticketPurchases  TicketPurchase[]\n  auditLogs        AuditLog[]\n}\n\nmodel Merchant {\n  ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\DEPLOYMENT.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 82
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 165
          }
        },
        "contents": "1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;\n4. **Set secrets**: &#96;fly secrets set KEY=value&#96;\n5. **Deploy**: &#96;fly deploy&#96;\n\n### Self-Hosted (Docker)\n\n1. **Build Docker image**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile\n   FROM node:18-alpine\n   WORKDIR /app\n   COPY package*.json ./\n   RUN npm ci --only=production\n   COPY . .\n   RUN npm run build\n   CMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Run with docker-compose**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n   services:\n     app:\n       build: .\n       ports:\n         - \"3000:3000\"\n       environment:\n         - DATABASE_URL=...\n         - NEXTAUTH_SECRET=...\n       depends_on:\n         - postgres\n         - redis\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Migrations\n\nIn production, use migrations instead of &#96;db:push&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run db:migrate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis creates a migration file that can be reviewed before applying.\n\n## Post-Deployment\n\n1. **Verify health**: Check &#96;/&#96; endpoint\n2. **Test authentication**: Try login flow\n3. **Test voucher creation**: Create a test voucher\n4. **Test redemption flow**: Complete end-to-end test\n5. **Monitor logs**: Check for errors\n6. **Set up monitoring**: Use Sentry, LogRocket, etc.\n\n## Scaling Considerations\n\n- **Database**: Use connection pooling (PgBouncer)\n- **Redis**: Use Redis Cluster for high availability\n- **CDN**: Use Vercel Edge Network or Cloudflare\n- **File Storage**: Use S3-compatible storage for brand assets\n- **Rate Limiting**: Configure Redis-based rate limiting\n- **Caching**: Cache public voucher pages\n\n## Security\n\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] Environment variables secured (never commit to git)\n- [ ] Database credentials rotated regularly\n- [ ] OAuth redirect URIs configured correctly\n- [ ] CORS configured (if needed)\n- [ ] Rate limiting enabled\n- [ ] Audit logging enabled\n\n## Backup Strategy\n\n1. **Database backups**: Daily automated backups\n2. **File backups**: S3 versioning enabled\n3. **Configuration backups**: Store env vars securely\n4. **Test restore**: Regularly test backup restoration\n\n## Monitoring",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# Quick Start Guide\n\n## Ühe käsuga (soovitus) — &#96;dev:full&#96;\n\nKui Docker Desktop on käivitatud:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee käivitab: Postgres, loob/värskendab &#96;.env.local&#96;, teeb &#96;db push&#96;, &#96;db:seed&#96; ja &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;, siis dev-serveri.\n\n**Testikasutaja:** &#96;test@example.com&#96; / &#96;test123&#96;  \n**Lehed:** &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → /app (Coffee House: Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard)\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ installed\n- Docker Desktop installed and running\n- Git (optional)\n\n## Setup Steps\n\n1. **Install dependencies**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set up environment**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Copy the example env file\n   # Edit .env and set:\n   # - AUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - NEXTAUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - DATABASE_URL (already set for Docker)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Start database and initialize**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended)\n   npm run db:setup\n   \n   # Or manually:\n   npm run db:check      # Check Docker Desktop\n   npm run docker:up     # Start containers\n   npm run db:wait       # Wait for database\n   npm run db:push       # Push schema\n   npm run db:seed       # Seed data\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Start development server**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Open browser**:\n   Navigate to &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt;\n\n## Test the Flow\n\n1. **View a voucher** (after creating one):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&gt;\n   - Replace [voucherId] with an actual voucher ID from your database\n   - Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Login** (e‑post + parool):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt;\n   - [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) / **test123** (Credentials; töötab kohe kui &#96;dev:full&#96; või &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; on käivitatud)\n   - Või [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com) — magic link (vajab SMTP) või OAuth\n\n3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:\n\n   - &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;: PostgreSQL connection string\n   - &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - &#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - OAuth providers (optional for local dev)\n   - SMTP settings (for email magic links)\n\n1. Start Docker services and set up database:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended - checks Docker, starts containers, waits for DB, pushes schema, seeds)\n   npm run db:setup\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Or manually:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Check Docker Desktop is running\n   npm run db:check\n\n   # Start Docker containers\n   npm run docker:up\n\n   # Wait for database to be ready\n   npm run db:wait\n\n   # Push database schema\n   npm run db:push\n\n   # Seed database\n   npm run db:seed\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   **Troubleshooting**: If you encounter Docker issues, see [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)\n\n1. Start the development server:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOpen [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.\n\n## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96;         "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "function LoginForm() {\nconst handleEmailSignIn = async \n\n    await signIn('email', { email, callbackUrl });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;Card className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n          &lt;CardTitle&gt;Sisselogimine&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n          &lt;CardDescription&gt;\n            Logi sisse e‑posti ja parooliga või sotsiaalvõrgustike kaudu\n          &lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n        &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n        &lt;CardContent className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n          &lt;form onSubmit={handleCredentialsSignIn} className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"cred-email\"&gt;E‑post (kasutajanimi)&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"cred-email\"\n                name=\"email\"\n                type=\"email\"\n                placeholder=\"teie@näide.ee\"\n                value={email}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; setEmail(e.target.value)}\n                required\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"cred-password\"&gt;Parool&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"cred-password\"\n                name=\"password\"\n                type=\"password\"\n                placeholder=\"••••••••\"\n                value={password}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; setPassword(e.target.value)}\n                required\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            {error &amp;&amp; &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-destructive\"&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;}\n            &lt;Button type=\"submit\" className=\"w-full\" disabled={isLoading}&gt;\n              {isLoading ?         "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "# V2 Backlog\n\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\n\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\n\n### Marketplace &amp; Discovery\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\n- ❌ Deals feed\n- ❌ Ad network\n- ❌ Social platform features\n\n### Social Features\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\n\n### Loyalty &amp; Tiers\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\n- ❌ Points systems\n- ❌ Gamification\n\n### AI Features\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\n- ❌ AI content generation\n\n### Advertising\n- ❌ Ad placements\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\n\n### Influencer Features\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\n- ❌ Creator monetization\n\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\n\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog items:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet**\n   - Add vouchers to native wallet apps\n   - QR codes in wallet format\n\n2. **Push Notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n   - Credit expiry warnings\n\n3. **Multi-language Selector**\n   - User-selectable language (beyond browser detection)\n   - Language preferences per user\n\n4. **Custom Domains**\n   - Merchant-branded domains\n   - White-label subdomains\n\n5. **POS Deep Integrations**\n   - Direct POS system integration\n   - Real-time inventory sync\n   - Automated redemption confirmation\n\n6. **Analytics Exports**\n   - PDF reports\n   - CSV exports (already have for redemptions)\n   - Scheduled reports\n\n7. **White-label Mode**\n   - Fully branded merchant experience\n   - Remove platform branding\n   - Custom email templates\n\n## Current Non-MVP Pages (For Reference)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in MVP scope:\n\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Platform admin (internal use for launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Analytics dashboard (V2)",

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "## Business Rules",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "export default function QRDownload({ qrCodeDataUrl, filename = 'voucher-qr' }: QRDownloadProps) {\n  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleDownload = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setIsDownloading(true);\n      \n      // Convert data URL to blob\n      const response = await fetch(qrCodeDataUrl);\n      const blob = await response.blob();\n      \n      // Create download link\n      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const link = document.createElement('a');\n      link.href = url;\n      link.download = &#96;${filename}-${Date.now()}.png&#96;;\n      document.body.appendChild(link);\n      link.click();\n      document.body.removeChild(link);\n      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n      \n      showSuccess('QR code downloaded successfully!');\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError('Failed to download QR code');\n      console.error(error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsDownloading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      variant=\"outline\"\n      onClick={handleDownload}\n      disabled={isDownloading || !qrCodeDataUrl}\n      size=\"sm\"\n    &gt;\n      &lt;Download className=\"h-4 w-4 mr-2\" /&gt;\n      {isDownloading ?         "contents": "| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. This rewards referrals. |\n| \"Will people abuse it?\" | Credits are locked, controlled, and merchant-specific. |\n| \"Do I need an app?\" | No. It works instantly on any phone. |\n\n---\n\n## Demo pitch (under 3 minutes)\n\n**Order:** 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6.\n\n1. **Open voucher landing** — Show &#96;/v/[id]&#96;, merchant brand, value, one clear CTA.\n2. **Share** — Tap \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\", get &#96;/r/[id]&#96;, show native share or copy.\n3. **Redeem as friend** — Open link in new session, redeem online or in-store (QR).\n4. **Confirm** — Staff confirms in dashboard; show redemption moving to \"Confirmed\".\n5. **Credit unlock** — Show referrer's wallet: locked → available after confirm.\n6. **Apply credit** — Checkout demo: apply credit, new total. Done.\n\n**Talking point:** \"Branded, tracked, controlled by you. You only pay when it works.\"",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = referral.voucher.designJson\n    ? (JSON.parse(referral.voucher.designJson as string) as Record&lt;string, any&gt;)\n    : null;\n\n  const brandColors = referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson\n    ?         "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Weekly drop sold out') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error claiming weekly drop:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;         "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n          ) : (\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n              &lt;div&gt;\n                &lt;Label htmlFor=\"orderAmount\" className=\"text-sm font-medium\"&gt;\n                  Order amount (for online use)\n                &lt;/Label&gt;\n                &lt;Input\n                  id=\"orderAmount\"\n                  type=\"number\"\n                  placeholder=\"e.g. 50\"\n                  value={orderAmount}\n                  onChange={(e) =&gt; setOrderAmount(e.target.value)}\n                  disabled={isRedeeming}\n                  className=\"mt-2 h-11\"\n                /&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n                &lt;Button\n                  className=\"w-full h-12 font-medium bg-[var(--brand-primary)] text-white hover:opacity-90\"\n                  onClick={() =&gt; handleRedeem('online')}\n                  disabled={!orderAmount || isRedeeming}\n                &gt;\n                  {isRedeeming ?         "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError('You cannot redeem your own referral link');\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Redemption failed');\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess('Show the QR below to staff. Waiting for merchant confirmation.');\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(&#96;Discount applied: ${formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency)}&#96;);\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Redemption failed');\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const fromName = referral.referrer?.name || 'a friend';\n  const scope = &#96;ref-${String(referral.id).replace(/\\s/g, '')}&#96;;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={&#96;${scope}\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Kokkuvõte tehtud muudatustest:

## Täidetud täiendused

### 1. OAuth providerid
- Lisatud `lib/auth.ts`:
  - Facebook
  - GitHub
  - Twitter/X
  - LinkedIn
- Providerid on tingimuslikud (näidatakse, kui env muutujad on seadistatud)

### 2. Login leht
- Uuendatud `app/[locale]/login/page.tsx`:
  - Kõik OAuth providerid ikoonidega
  - Grid paigutus (2 veergu)
  - Ikonid: Chrome (Google), Apple, Facebook, Github, Twitter, Linkedin

### 3. Sotsiaalmeedia jagamise komponent
- Loodud `components/social-share.tsx`:
  - Facebook
  - Twitter/X
  - LinkedIn
  - WhatsApp
  - Email
  - Linki kopeerimine
- Toetab native share API-d (mobiil)
- Fallback URL-idele, kui native share puudub

### 4. Share nupud integreeritud
- `app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx` — share nupud voucher lehel
- `app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx` — share nupud referral lehel
- Mõlemal lehel on eraldi sektsioon "Share on social media"

### 5. Tõlked
- Lisatud `messages/en.json` ja `messages/et.json`:
  - `share.share`, `share.shareOnFacebook`, jne
  - `share.copyLink`, `share.copied`, `share.linkCopied`
  - Kõik platvormid tõlgitud

## Vajalikud environment muutujad

OAuth providerite jaoks lisa `.env` faili:

```bash
# OAuth Providers
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_google_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_google_client_secret

APPLE_CLIENT_ID=your_apple_client_id
APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_apple_client_secret

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_facebook_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_facebook_app_secret

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_github_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_github_client_secret

TWITTER_CLIENT_ID=your_twitter_client_id
TWITTER_CLIENT_SECRET=your_twitter_client_secret

LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID=your_linkedin_client_id
LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET=your_linkedin_client_secret
```

## Tulemused

- 6 OAuth providerit (Google, Apple, Facebook, GitHub, Twitter, LinkedIn)
- Share nupud kõikidel voucher ja referral lehtedel
- 5 sotsiaalmeedia platvormi (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Email)
- Tõlked kõikidele funktsioonidele
- Responsive disain
- Native share API tugi (mobiil)

Kõik sotsiaalmeedia sisselogimise ja jagamise võimalused on nüüd integreeritud.

Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service\n7. **Redis**: Create Redis service (optional)\n\n### Fly.io\n\n1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {

          {
            "text": "import { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral } from '@/lib/fraud';",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "import { z } from 'zod';",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "const createRedemptionSchema = z.object({",

          },
          {
            "text": "  voucherId: z.string(),",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  referralId: z.string().optional(),",

          {
            "text": "  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
