        "contents": "| Objection | Response |\n| --- | --- |\n| \"Isn't this just coupons?\" | No. Coupons discount. This rewards referrals. |\n| \"Will people abuse it?\" | Credits are locked, controlled, and merchant-specific. |\n| \"Do I need an app?\" | No. It works instantly on any phone. |\n\n---\n\n## Demo pitch (under 3 minutes)\n\n**Order:** 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6.\n\n1. **Open voucher landing** — Show &#96;/v/[id]&#96;, merchant brand, value, one clear CTA.\n2. **Share** — Tap \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\", get &#96;/r/[id]&#96;, show native share or copy.\n3. **Redeem as friend** — Open link in new session, redeem online or in-store (QR).\n4. **Confirm** — Staff confirms in dashboard; show redemption moving to \"Confirmed\".\n5. **Credit unlock** — Show referrer's wallet: locked → available after confirm.\n6. **Apply credit** — Checkout demo: apply credit, new total. Done.\n\n**Talking point:** \"Branded, tracked, controlled by you. You only pay when it works.\"",

        "contents": "- &#96;/admin&#96; - Platform admin (internal use for launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Analytics dashboard (V2)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - Referral analytics (V2)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Member management (internal use)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant landing page (should be removed)\n\n## Notes\n\n- MVP focuses on core flows: create → share → redeem → confirm → unlock → apply\n- All features must align with \"merchant-powered referral infrastructure\" identity\n- No public discovery or marketplace features\n- Platform brand should be minimal; merchant brand dominates",

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

Kokkuvõte tehtud muudatustest:

## Täielik Stripe makse süsteem

### 1. API endpointid
- `app/api/vouchers/[id]/purchase/route.ts` — voucher ostmine Stripe checkout'iga
- `app/api/tickets/[id]/purchase/route.ts` — ticket ostmine Stripe checkout'iga
- `app/api/payment/verify/route.ts` — makse staatuse kontrollimine
- `app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` — Stripe webhook käsitleja (checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed)

### 2. Makse lehed
- `app/payment/success/page.tsx` — makse õnnestumise leht
- `app/payment/cancel/page.tsx` — makse tühistamise leht
- `app/payment/error/page.tsx` — makse vea leht
- `app/app/payments/page.tsx` — maksete ajalugu (vouchers + tickets)

### 3. UI integratsioon
- Voucher lehel (`app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx`):
  - Ostunupp, kui voucher on tasuline (campaign price)
  - "Get this voucher" nupp, kui voucher on tasuta
  - Share nupp autenditud kasutajatele
- Payment history link navigatsioonis (`app/app/layout.tsx`)

### 4. Tõlked
- Lisatud `messages/en.json` ja `messages/et.json`:
  - `payment.purchase`, `payment.purchaseFor`
  - `payment.processing`, `payment.purchaseFailed`
  - `payment.codeCopied`, `payment.getVoucher`
  - `payment.successTitle`, `payment.successDescription`
  - `payment.cancelTitle`, `payment.cancelDescription`
  - `payment.errorTitle`, `payment.errorDescription`
  - `payment.paymentHistory`, `payment.paymentHistoryDescription`
  - `payment.noPayments`, `payment.noPaymentsDescription`
  - `payment.view`, `payment.unknownItem`
  - `nav.payments`

### 5. Stripe integratsioon
- `lib/stripe.ts` — Stripe client ja helper funktsioonid
- Webhook käsitleb:
  - `checkout.session.completed` — makse õnnestumine
  - `payment_intent.succeeded` — makse kinnitamine
  - `payment_intent.payment_failed` — makse ebaõnnestumine
- Automaatne email saatmine (receipt, voucher delivery, ticket confirmation)
- Automaatne credit'ide jagamine referrer'itele

### 6. Tulemused
- Täielik voucher ostmine Stripe'iga
- Täielik ticket ostmine Stripe'iga
- Webhook käsitlemine kõikidele sündmustele
- Makse lehed (success, cancel, error)
- Maksete ajalugu kasutajale
- Tõlked kõikidele funktsioonidele
- Payment history link navigatsioonis

## Vajalikud environment muutujad

```bash
# Stripe
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_...
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...
NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_test_...
```

## Testimise sammud

1. Loo voucher campaign'iga hinnaga
2. Ava voucher leht (`/v/[id]`)
3. Kliki "Purchase for €X.XX"
4. Täida Stripe checkout
5. Kontrolli `/payment/success` lehte
6. Kontrolli `/app/payments` lehte
7. Kontrolli, et webhook töötab (Stripe dashboard)

Stripe makse süsteem on nüüd täielik ja valmis kasutamiseks.

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

## Tehtud muudatused

### 1. Error lehtede tõlked
- `app/error.tsx` — kasutab `useTranslations` error sõnumite jaoks
- `app/not-found.tsx` — kasutab `getTranslations` 404 sõnumite jaoks
- `app/global-error.tsx` — kommentaar, et see on kriitiline error boundary

### 2. Tickets page tõlked
- `app/app/tickets/page.tsx` — kõik hardcoded stringid asendatud tõlgetega
- Lisatud tõlked: `myTickets`, `myTicketsDescription`, `event`, `date`, `status`, `location`, `viewTicket`

### 3. Voucher client parandused
- `app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx` — "Copied" asendatud `t('codeCopied')`-ga

### 4. Tõlked
- `messages/en.json`:
  - `errors.somethingWentWrong`, `errors.errorOccurred`, `errors.criticalError`
  - `errors.notFound` (parandatud)
  - `common.tryAgain`
  - `analytics.myTickets`, `analytics.myTicketsDescription`, `analytics.event`, `analytics.date`, `analytics.status`, `analytics.location`, `analytics.viewTicket`
- `messages/et.json`:
  - Samad tõlked eesti keeles

### 5. Login page
- `app/[locale]/login/page.tsx` — lisatud `tCommon` loading state'i jaoks

## Järgmised võimalikud sammud (veel tegemata)

1. Placeholder'ite tõlked — vormides on veel hardcoded placeholder'e (nt "you@example.com", "••••••••")
2. Form validation sõnumid — Zod error sõnumid võivad vajada tõlkeid
3. Accessibility parandused — rohkem `aria-label`-e
4. Email template'id — kui need on, võivad vajada tõlkeid

Kõik peamised error lehed, tickets page ja voucher client on nüüd tõlgitud.

        "contents": "# Toast Notifications Migration Guide\n\n## Asendada alert() kutsed toast'idega\n\n### Enne:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nalert('Voucher published successfully!');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pärast:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Voucher published successfully!');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Näited kasutamisest\n\n### Success toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Voucher created successfully!');\nshowSuccess('Credit applied!', 'Success');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Error toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showError } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowError('Failed to create voucher');\nshowError('Insufficient credit balance', 'Error');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Info toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showInfo } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowInfo('Processing your request...');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Loading Button kasutamine\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { LoadingButton } from '@/components/ui/loading-button';\n\n&lt;LoadingButton \n  loading={isLoading} \n  loadingText=\"Publishing...\"\n  onClick={handlePublish}\n&gt;\n  Publish Voucher\n&lt;/LoadingButton&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Failid, mida uuendada\n\n1. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/publish-button.tsx&#96;\n2. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n3. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n4. &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n5. &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n6. &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function Error({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  const t = useTranslations('errors');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Log to console in dev\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Route error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"max-w-md w-full text-center space-y-4\"&gt;\n        &lt;h1 className=\"text-xl font-semibold\"&gt;{t('somethingWentWrong')}&lt;/h1&gt;\n        &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n          {t('errorOccurred')}\n        &lt;/p&gt;\n        &lt;Button onClick={reset}&gt;{tCommon('tryAgain')}&lt;/Button&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

Kokkuvõte tehtud muudatustest:

## Tehtud muudatused

### 1. Placeholder'ite tõlked
- Lisatud `placeholders` sektsioon `messages/en.json` ja `messages/et.json`:
  - `email`, `password`, `website`, `supportEmail`, `logoUrl`
  - `colorHex`, `orderAmount`, `qrToken`
  - `locationName`, `locationAddress`, `capacity`, `price`
  - `eventDescription`, `eventTerms`
  - `campaignName`, `campaignDescription`, `unlimited`, `duration`

### 2. Login lehe parandused
- `app/[locale]/login/page.tsx`:
  - Email placeholder kasutab `t('emailPlaceholder')`
  - Password placeholder kasutab `t('passwordPlaceholder')`
  - "Parool" label kasutab `t('password')`
  - "Sisselogi" nupp kasutab `t('signIn')`

### 3. Referral client parandused
- `app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx`:
  - Lisatud `useTranslations('placeholders')`
  - Order amount placeholder kasutab `tPlaceholder('orderAmount')`

### 4. Tõlked
- `messages/en.json`:
  - `auth.password` - "Password"
  - `auth.emailPlaceholder` - "you@example.com"
  - `auth.passwordPlaceholder` - "••••••••"
  - Uus `placeholders` sektsioon kõigi placeholder'itega
- `messages/et.json`:
  - `auth.password` - "Parool"
  - `auth.emailPlaceholder` - "sina@näide.ee"
  - `auth.passwordPlaceholder` - "••••••••"
  - Uus `placeholders` sektsioon eesti keeles

## Järgmised võimalikud sammud (veel tegemata)

1. Form validation sõnumid — Zod error sõnumid võivad vajada tõlkeid
2. Accessibility parandused — rohkem `aria-label` atribuute
3. Merchant vormide placeholder'id — veel mõned vormid vajavad tõlkeid (onboarding, events, campaigns)

Peamised placeholder'id on nüüd tõlgitud. Login leht ja referral client kasutavad tõlkeid.

        "contents": "export function showError(message: string, title?: string) {\n  toast({\n    variant: \"destructive\",\n    title: title || \"Error\",\n    description: message,\n  });\n}\n\nexport function showInfo(message: string, title?: string) {\n  toast({\n    title: title || \"Info\",\n    description: message,\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "# Toast Notifications Migration Guide\n\n## Asendada alert() kutsed toast'idega\n\n### Enne:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nalert('Voucher published successfully!');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pärast:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Voucher published successfully!');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Näited kasutamisest\n\n### Success toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Voucher created successfully!');\nshowSuccess('Credit applied!', 'Success');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Error toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showError } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowError('Failed to create voucher');\nshowError('Insufficient credit balance', 'Error');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Info toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showInfo } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowInfo('Processing your request...');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Loading Button kasutamine\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { LoadingButton } from '@/components/ui/loading-button';\n\n&lt;LoadingButton \n  loading={isLoading} \n  loadingText=\"Publishing...\"\n  onClick={handlePublish}\n&gt;\n  Publish Voucher\n&lt;/LoadingButton&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Failid, mida uuendada\n\n1. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/publish-button.tsx&#96;\n2. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n3. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n4. &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n5. &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n6. &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Toast Notifications Migration Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Asendada alert() kutsed toast'idega",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### Enne:",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "alert('Voucher published successfully!');",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "### Pärast:",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "showSuccess('Voucher published successfully!');",
            "lineNumber": 14

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "## Näited kasutamisest",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### Success toast",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "import { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "showSuccess('Voucher created successfully!');",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "showSuccess('Credit applied!', 'Success');",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "### Error toast",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "import { showError } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "showError('Insufficient credit balance', 'Error');",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "### Info toast",

          },
          {

          },
          {

        "contents": "type FormData = \n\n  codePrefix: string;\n};\n\nconst initial: FormData = {\n  type: 'percentage',\n  value: '',\n  currency: 'USD',\n  validFrom: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],\n  validTo: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],\n  usageLimitTotal: '',\n  usageLimitPerUser: '',\n  weeklyDropEnabled: false,\n  weeklyDropDay: '1',\n  weeklyDropTime: '10:00',\n  weeklyDropStock: '20',\n  weeklyDropDuration: '60',\n  designHeadline: '',\n  designFinePrint: '',\n  designPrimaryColor: '#18181b',\n  designSecondaryColor: '#71717a',\n  designBackgroundColor: '#fafafa',\n  codePrefix: '',\n};\n\nfunction VoucherPreview({ form }: { form: FormData }) {\n  const val = parseInt(form.value, 10) || 0;\n  const valueStr =\n    form.type === 'percentage'\n      ?         "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred.         "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\nimport { signIn } from 'next-auth/react';\nimport { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';\nimport { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { Chrome, Apple, Facebook, Github, Twitter, Linkedin } from 'lucide-react';\n\nconst TEST_EMAIL = 'test@example.com';\nconst TEST_PASSWORD = 'test123';\n\nfunction LoginForm() {\n  const t = useTranslations('auth');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const callbackUrl = searchParams.get('callbackUrl') ?? '/app';\n\n  const handleCredentialsSignIn = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const res = await signIn('credentials', { email, password, callbackUrl, redirect: false });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n    if (res?.error) {\n      setError('Vale e‑post või parool.');\n      return;\n    }\n    if (res?.ok) router.push(res.url ?? callbackUrl);\n  };\n\n  const handleEmailSignIn = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    await signIn('email', { email, callbackUrl });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "# Toast Notifications Migration Guide\n\n## Asendada alert() kutsed toast'idega\n\n### Enne:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nalert('Voucher published successfully!');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Pärast:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Voucher published successfully!');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Näited kasutamisest\n\n### Success toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Voucher created successfully!');\nshowSuccess('Credit applied!', 'Success');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Error toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showError } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowError('Failed to create voucher');\nshowError('Insufficient credit balance', 'Error');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Info toast\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showInfo } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowInfo('Processing your request...');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Loading Button kasutamine\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { LoadingButton } from '@/components/ui/loading-button';\n\n&lt;LoadingButton \n  loading={isLoading} \n  loadingText=\"Publishing...\"\n  onClick={handlePublish}\n&gt;\n  Publish Voucher\n&lt;/LoadingButton&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Failid, mida uuendada\n\n1. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/publish-button.tsx&#96;\n2. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n3. &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n4. &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n5. &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n6. &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\nconst calculateDiscount = \n {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError('You cannot redeem your own referral link');\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Redemption failed');\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess('Show the QR below to staff. Waiting for merchant confirmation.');\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(&#96;Discount applied: ${formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency)}&#96;);\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Redemption failed');\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const fromName = referral.referrer?.name || 'a friend';\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1.         "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96;         "contents": "# Täiustuste plaan\n\n## Prioriteet 1: UX täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications\n- ✅ Asendada kõik &#96;alert()&#96; kutsed toast notification'itega\n- ✅ Success, error, info toast'id\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ Button loading states\n- ✅ Page loading skeletons\n- ✅ Form submission indicators\n\n### 3. Analytics &amp; Statistika\n- ✅ Dashboard graafikud (Chart.js või Recharts)\n- ✅ Voucher performance metrics\n- ✅ Referral conversion rates\n- ✅ Credit usage analytics\n\n### 4. Parem Error Handling UI\n- ✅ Error boundaries\n- ✅ User-friendly error messages\n- ✅ Retry mechanisms\n\n## Prioriteet 2: Funktsionaalsed täiustused\n\n### 5. Voucher Otsing &amp; Filtreerimine\n- ✅ Otsing voucher'ite hulgas\n- ✅ Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n- ✅ Sortimine\n\n### 6. Voucher Mallid\n- ✅ Eeldefineeritud mallid\n- ✅ Mallide salvestamine\n- ✅ Kiire voucher'ite loomine mallidest\n\n### 7. Bulk Operations\n- ✅ Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine/pausimine\n- ✅ CSV export/import\n- ✅ Bulk redemptions\n\n### 8. Email Notifications\n- ✅ Credit unlock notifications\n- ✅ Redemption confirmations\n- ✅ Weekly drop reminders\n- ✅ Credit expiry warnings\n\n## Prioriteet 3: Täiendavad funktsioonid\n\n### 9. Parem Navigation\n- ✅ Mobile-friendly navigation\n- ✅ Breadcrumbs\n- ✅ Quick actions menu\n\n### 10. Export Funktsioonid\n- ✅ Redemptions CSV export\n- ✅ Credits ledger export\n- ✅ Analytics reports PDF\n\n### 11. Voucher Kategooriad\n- ✅ Kategooriate süsteem\n- ✅ Filtreerimine kategooria järgi\n- ✅ Kategooriate haldus\n\n### 12. Advanced Analytics\n- ✅ Referral tracking (UTM parameters)\n- ✅ Conversion funnels\n- ✅ Cohort analysis\n- ✅ Revenue attribution\n\n## Prioriteet 4: Tehnilised täiustused\n\n### 13. Caching Strategy\n- ✅ Redis caching public voucher pages\n- ✅ API response caching\n- ✅ Optimistic updates\n\n### 14.         "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n    let url = window.location.href;\n    if (isAuthenticated) {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch('/api/referrals/create', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n          body: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: voucher.id }),\n        });\n        const data = await res.json();\n        if (data.shareUrl) url = data.shareUrl;\n      } catch {\n        // use /v/ link as fallback\n      }\n    }\n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: design?.headline || 'Special Offer',\n          text: &#96;Check out this voucher from ${voucher.merchant.name}&#96;,\n          url,\n        });\n        showSuccess('Link shared');\n      } catch {\n        // cancelled or error\n      }\n    } else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo('Link copied to clipboard');\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n              You cannot redeem your own referral link\n            &lt;/p&gt;\n          ) : (\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n              &lt;div&gt;\n                &lt;Label htmlFor=\"orderAmount\" className=\"text-sm font-medium\"&gt;\n                  Order amount (for online use)\n                &lt;/Label&gt;\n                &lt;Input\n                  id=\"orderAmount\"\n                  type=\"number\"\n                  placeholder={tPlaceholder('orderAmount')}\n                  value={orderAmount}\n                  onChange={(e) =&gt; setOrderAmount(e.target.value)}\n                  disabled={isRedeeming}\n                  className=\"mt-2 h-11\"\n                /&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n                &lt;Button\n                  className=\"w-full h-12 font-medium bg-[var(--brand-primary)] text-white hover:opacity-90\"\n                  onClick={() =&gt; handleRedeem('online')}\n                  disabled={!orderAmount || isRedeeming}\n                  aria-label={isRedeeming ? 'Processing…' : 'Use online'}\n                &gt;\n                  {isRedeeming ? 'Processing…' : 'Use online'}\n                &lt;/Button&gt;\n                &lt;Button\n                  variant=\"outline\"\n                  className=\"w-full h-12\"\n                  onClick={() =&gt; handleRedeem('in_store')}\n                  disabled={isRedeeming}\n                  aria-label={isRedeeming ? 'Processing…' : 'Show QR in store'}\n                &gt;\n                  {isRedeeming ? 'Processing…' : 'Show QR in store'}\n                &lt;/Button&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          )}\n\n          &lt;div ref={qrRef} className=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-2 pt-2\"&gt;\n            {qrCodeDataUrl &amp;&amp; (\n              &lt;&gt;\n                &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;Show this QR at the register&lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;Image\n                  src={qrCodeDataUrl}\n                  alt=\"\"\n                  width={200}\n                  height={200}\n                  className=\"rounded-lg border border-border\"\n                /&gt;\n              &lt;/&gt;\n            )}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\nconst calculateDiscount = \n {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError('You cannot redeem your own referral link');\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Redemption failed');\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess('Show the QR below to staff. Waiting for merchant confirmation.');\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(&#96;Discount applied: ${formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency)}&#96;);\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Redemption failed');\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const fromName = referral.referrer?.name || 'a friend';\n}",

## Tehtud muudatused

### 1. Referral client tõlked
- `app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx` — kõik hardcoded stringid asendatud tõlgetega:
  - "You got a voucher from" → `tReferral('voucherFrom')`
  - "No app required" → `tReferral('noAppRequired')`
  - "You cannot redeem your own referral link" → `tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn')`
  - "Order amount (for online use)" → `tReferral('orderAmountLabel')`
  - "Processing…" → `tReferral('processing')`
  - "Use online" → `tReferral('useOnline')`
  - "Show QR in store" → `tReferral('showQrInStore')`
  - "Show the QR below to staff..." → `tReferral('showQrToStaff')`
  - "Discount applied:" → `tReferral('discountApplied', { amount })`
  - "Redemption failed" → `tReferral('redemptionFailed')`
  - "Special Offer" → `tReferral('specialOffer')`
  - "a friend" → `tReferral('aFriend')`
  - "Show this QR at the register" → `tReferral('showQrAtRegister')`
  - "Share on social media" → `tReferral('shareOnSocialMedia')`
  - "Valid until" → `tReferral('validUntil')`
  - " - Shared by a friend!" → `tReferral('sharedByFriend')`

### 2. Voucher client tõlked
- `app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx` — kõik hardcoded stringid asendatud tõlgetega:
  - "Special Offer" → `tVoucher('specialOffer')`
  - "Check out this voucher from" → `tVoucher('checkOutVoucher')`
  - "Link shared" → `tVoucher('linkShared')`
  - "Link copied to clipboard" → `tVoucher('linkCopied')`
  - "First X uses" → `tVoucher('firstUses', { count })`
  - "Valid until" → `tVoucher('validUntil')`

### 3. Tõlked
- `messages/en.json`:
  - Lisatud `referral` sektsioon kõigi referral client stringidega
  - Lisatud `voucher` sektsiooni: `specialOffer`, `checkOutVoucher`, `linkShared`, `linkCopied`, `firstUses`, `validUntil`
- `messages/et.json`:
  - Samad tõlked eesti keeles
